nodes.description: Analyzes finite, nonempty interleaved audio without modifying it. RMS uses all samples across all channels; dBFS is 20*log10(RMS), floored at -120 dB and may be positive. Clipping ratio counts samples outside [-1, 32767/32768], matching PCM16 WAV clipping. Silence ratio is low-level frame coverage, not speech VAD: contiguous nominal 20 ms windows use max(1, (sample_rate+25)/50) frames, RMS across all channels, and RMS <= 10^(silence_threshold_db/20). The final short window uses its actual length; low-level window frames divided by total frames give the ratio.

parameters.description: Finite low-level window RMS threshold; this is not voice activity detection.
